function.name: ast_edit
function.description: Precisely edit a specific Python function or class using AST (tree-sitter), without rewriting the whole file. It automatically checks syntax after editing and rolls back if errors are found.

file_path.description: Path to the python file to edit

node_type.description: Type of the node to replace (function or class)

node_name.description: Name of the function or class

new_code.description: The complete new code for the function or class to replace the old one. Must have correct indentation relative to its scope.
